claims.claim: As of Oct. 30 she had not been found and no arrest had been announced.
FBI Director Kash Patel wrote that investigators recovered footage from "residual data located in backend systems." Google said it was assisting and gave no further detail.
Investigators narrowed it by removing devices also present before and after the breach, then obtained subscriber details for about 1,535.
The Justice Department charged about 1,583 people over four years.
FACT Reporting by IEEE Spectrum found fewer than 200 had been charged using the geofence data.
REPORTED On Jan. 20, 2025, President Trump commuted 14 sentences, pardoned everyone else convicted, and ordered pending cases dismissed; news reports put the total at about 1,500.
REPORTED The pardons ended the prosecutions; nothing we found says the collected records were destroyed.
